purpose: Illustrative direct-provider contracts. This file is not read by side-lane and does not enable a provider, credential lookup, or dispatch.

providers.notes: Illustrative routed-provider shape only. A routed provider forwards the requested selector to a declared upstream pool it selects itself; every streamed attested model must fall inside allowed_upstream_models (missing, unknown, or out-of-pool attestation fails the run closed), and the receipt records the attested model set, never the selector alias as actual identity. A bare model id can collide across upstream providers, so attestation is model evidence only, never upstream provider identity. Deployment-specific base_url values, credential_service names, and exact upstream ids are private configuration and never belong in this public package; settings_precedence here shows the activation requirement, not a verification this file performs.
